## Purpose & Scope  
### Purpose  
To establish procedures for operational risk management that:
- Identify operational risks proactively
- Assess risk impact and likelihood
- Implement mitigation controls
- Monitor risk metrics
- Report to senior management and Board
name: Chunk 3/32

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Management Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy establishing procedures for the bank's operational risk management framework. The policy mandates proactive identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting of operational risks to senior management and the Board.
context: To establish procedures for operational risk management that:
Report to senior management and Board

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk category that the policy is designed to address through proactive identification, assessment, and mitigation. Operational risk encompasses events and exposures that require monitoring and control to prevent adverse impact on the bank's operations.
context: To establish procedures for operational risk management

raw_entities.name: Proactive Operational Risk Identification
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that the bank must identify operational risks proactively rather than reactively. This provision establishes the foundational obligation for the operational risk management framework.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Impact and Likelihood Assessment
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to assess both the impact and likelihood of identified operational risks. This provision establishes the analytical obligation for evaluating the severity and probability of operational risk events.

raw_entities.name: Implementation of Operational Risk Mitigation Controls
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to implement mitigation controls in response to identified and assessed operational risks. This provision establishes the obligation to deploy protective measures and safeguards.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Metrics Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to monitor operational risk metrics on an ongoing basis. This provision establishes the obligation for continuous surveillance and measurement of risk indicators.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Reporting to Senior Management and Board
raw_entities.description: A mandatory reporting obligation to communicate operational risk information, assessments, and metrics to senior management and the Board. This provision establishes the escalation and governance requirement for operational risk oversight.
context: Report to senior management and Board

raw_entities.name: Senior Management
raw_entities.description: Senior management holds accountability for receiving and acting upon operational risk reports and metrics. They are responsible for governance oversight of the operational risk management framework.
context: Report to senior management and Board

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: The Board holds ultimate accountability for operational risk governance and receives reports on operational risk metrics, assessments, and mitigation activities. The Board provides strategic oversight of the operational risk management framework.
context: Report to senior management and Board
